description: Block or unblock a member for yourself (private). A blocked member's messages read as "A blocked message". member = slug or display name; blocked=false unblocks.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

member.description: Slug or display name of the member

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

name: huddo_block
